contexts.text: There can be but one only true love; and therefore one only true life.
Not a single evil, or a single falsity, can be... abolished.
Not knowing but that such is the only life.
Thine only one, whom thou lovest () = the only one in the universe by which He was to save the human race.
That there is only one life...
This is the only truth of the Church; that is, the only one which makes man a Church.
The substance, which is substance, is only one ... and in the formations this one only substance reigns...
They call Him the one only Lord...
The Divine truth... is the one only thing from which are all things; for that which is the first is the one only thing in the sequents and derivatives.
The Divine truth is the one only substantial thing...
The good which is from the Lord is the one only thing from which are all truths.
That the Divine love and the Divine wisdom are... the Itself and the Only. General article.

The Only is said of that from which every other thing is. Now as the Itself and the Only is substance and form, it follows that it is the very and the only substance and form... It is the very and only love, and the very and only wisdom; thus the very and only essence, and the very and only life.
For the Infinite, that is, the Divine, is the one and only.
In all these the first thing is singly regnant in the sequents; nay, it is the one only thing in them; and, as it is the one only thing in them, it is the all in them.
The spiritual Sun is the one only substance from which all things are.

There is one only essence, one only substance, and one only form, from which are all essences, substances, and forms... That one only essence, substance, and form, is the Divine love and Divine wisdom... The One Only and Itself is omnipresent, omniscient, and omnipotent. And this One Only and Itself is the Lord from eternity. Explained. seriatim.
Which two are this one only life.

Who is the Itself and the Only from primes to ultimates... thus who is the very and only love, the very and only wisdom, and the very and only life in Himself; and thus the very and only Creator, Saviour, and Enlightener from Himself. Signified, Explained. AR 38.
The one only thing from which man is man, is...
A thousand things (contrasted With) only one thing.
A centre which he believed to be the only one.
That God is the Itself, the Only, and the First...
That true faith is the one only one... Explained.
Which recedes from the true faith which is the one only one...
There is not a single genuine truth left.
As if it only were in the light.
Redeemer. 10. 5. The Lord is the one and only God.
